usageNotes: Use this endpoint to poll the completion and outcome of any async PDM task after obtaining its UPID. Check the `status` field to distinguish a running task from a stopped one; only stopped tasks populate `exitstatus`, which will be 'OK' on success or 'Error: <msg>' on failure. The UPID must belong to the same node specified in the path — cross-node lookups will fail.

examples.summary: Check whether a remote sync task has finished and whether it succeeded

tips: Poll on a short interval (e.g. 2–5 seconds) until `status` transitions from 'running' to 'stopped', then read `exitstatus` for the final result.
Users can query their own tasks without extra privileges; checking another user's task requires Sys.Audit on /system/tasks.
The UPID encodes the node name — if the node segment in the UPID doesn't match the `node` path parameter, the request will return an error.
A stopped task with no `exitstatus` field indicates the task log was already pruned or the process was killed before it could write an exit code.
